text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As Smart Falcon's underpass live came to a 
successful close and we were seeing off 
the fans—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, everyooonne! Look forward to 
more from me~♪

text_block_list.name: Female Fan A
text_block_list.text: U-Um... Falco-chan...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Okaay☆ ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
You were in the very back row... The one 
holding the handmade fan, right? ♪

text_block_list.name: Female Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Huh, wha, m-me... what? There were other 
customers too... so why me!?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
You got the new fan today, didn't you? 
That made me so happy~☆ Thanks for always 
coming to my lives♪

text_block_list.name: Female Fan A
text_block_list.text:
No way, no way! Falco-chan, you're an 
absolute goddess! To think you actually 
remembered me...!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Jeez, you're exaggerating ☆ So, was there 
something you wanted to talk about?"

text_block_list.name: Female Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Th-That's right! I wanted to record 
a cheer message to send to my childhood 
friend back home... W-Would that be okay?

text_block_list.name: Female Fan A
text_block_list.text:
My childhood friend loves Falco-chan too, 
but she's so busy she can't leave our 
hometown...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Alright! I'll cheer you on with all my 
might: 'Hip, hip, hooray!'

text_block_list.name: Female Fan A
text_block_list.text:
A-A-An angel sent from God... I'm sure my 
childhood friend, who's been feeling down 
and depressed lately, will cheer up 
too...!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I see, something's troubling you. I hope 
my voice can cheer you up.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, I know! I just thought of 
something even better than a cheer 
message♪"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hey, what if Falco held a Winning Live in 
your hometown?!

text_block_list.name: Female Fan A
text_block_list.text:
I-If that's the case, my childhood friend 
can come to the concert too! B-B-But why 
go so far for me?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Rushing to wherever our fans are! That is 
what being an Umadol is all about☆

text_block_list.name: Female Fan A
text_block_list.text: Whaa-aaah... Fal-, Falco-cha...!

text_block_list.name: Female Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"S-So precious, it's too much! Too 
precious, I-I can't... breathe... Ngh, 
haah...!"
choice_data_list:
B-By the way, where are you from 
originally?

text_block_list.name: Female Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! Pardon me! Hokkaido! Could you come 
out to either Sapporo or Hakodate 
Racecourse...?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Waaah~~ Hokkaido, yay♪ Cheese, crab, so 
much delicious food! It'll give me lots of 
energy for the concert☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Trainer... Falco wants to go~ pretty 
please?"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yay♪ Well then, I'm gonna give it my all 
to become the center, so make sure to 
cheer for me☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon promised to perform at a 
Winning Live in her fans' hometown.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I need to plan a way to take 1st place in 
a race at Sapporo or Hakodate and claim 
center stage...!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon

so good~☆
